reviews.text: Sophie is FANTASTIC. I was so worried about my cat Esmeralda before the visit since we had never been to this clinic before. Sophie was so warm and attentive and my cat was so relaxed and comfortable and Sophie made her feel safe even though several uncomfortable procedures had to be done to her. She didn’t need sedation or anything and I’ve never seen her that calm during a vet visit. Insurance matters were handled flawlessly and this visit was just perfect from the moment we stepped inside the clinic. I will definitely be taking Esmeralda here in the future.
We received 6 STAR service (5 stars maximum) from Sophie and her team! Our little Pomeranian Kaja is like reborn, thank you!!!

I didn't book an appointment because after a paid wait (first I was told several times that the calls would be recorded, only many rounds later did the recording say that the staff was busy) I was answered by "artificial intelligence assistant Emma" etc. I don't want to deal with artificial intelligence, and I would like a smoother phone service, at least an alternative to artificial intelligence.

"Irresponsible clinic that only cares about money. Customer service is very poor. They gave my cat medicine at the wrong time and the medicine was far too strong for the little cat. I lost my beloved cat due to their carelessness and lack of responsibility, which ultimately led to paralysis. This is not the end of the story – I will continue to seek justice for my cat through legal means."
With the evidence, quality has deteriorated and prices have risen. Customer service is terrible.
Really good, professional and friendly service, thank you very much!
Very good and no problem people there. Good english and no bullshit, no forcing anything on my cat, good atmosphere and very clear info about price and operation. Much less stressfull than I thought.

Completely irresponsible veterinary clinic.

Here they prescribe strong antibiotics for all ailments to dogs with false diagnoses and then they cause serious ailments for the dogs.
Here they also prescribe antibiotics just to be on the safe side, without further examinations.

This was the second time this has happened to our family, we should have been wiser the first time.

The medical clinic has announced that they are monitoring how doctors prescribe antibiotic courses, but this does not comfort us when the damage has already been done.

A complaint has also been made to the medical clinic about the latter case.

If you care at all about your pets, you should avoid this place as much as possible.
Always super professional, gentle, and loving with our very sensitive dog. Sophie is a very knowledgeable and experienced vet we always trust and rely on. We are very happy clients! :)

Years with our dog as a customer here. The only place our dog really likes to come to. Always friendly service towards the dog, of course, for us too. I recommend it. The only downside is that you can't find a parking space for the car. A full ten for Sophie.
Sophie is absolutely wonderful and professional, definitely our new permanent veterinarian <3

What's the point in publishing opening hours if the vet likes to go home an hour early?

Nice I had to phone your €0.42/minute premium phone number to discover this...
